searchTerms.title: Search Terms / Keywords
searchTerms.description: List of keywords or topics to analyze on Google Trends (e.g. 'Artificial Intelligence', 'Bitcoin', 'Electric Cars').

geo.title: Geographic Region
geo.description: Country code (e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'DE', 'FR', 'SA', 'CA') or leave empty for Worldwide.

hl.title: Interface Language
hl.description: Language code for query and topic names (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'ar').

extractRelatedQueries.title: Extract Related Queries
extractRelatedQueries.description: Extract Top and Rising (Breakout) related searches.

extractRelatedTopics.title: Extract Related Topics
extractRelatedTopics.description: Extract Top and Rising related topic categories.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy to bypass rate-limits and regional blocks.
